pilot: ARIS4C015 Pilot M OpenAlex mechanism smoke v2
interpretation: A reproducible random 100-paper historical cohort contained no robust Sleeping Beauty under the variable-sleep, less-deep-inclusive retrospective gate.
The pipeline correctly blocked mechanism inference instead of manufacturing positive cases from cohort-relative ranks.
The result is a sample-yield diagnostic, not an estimate of Sleeping Beauty prevalence.
The next empirical step is a larger merged historical cohort or case-enriched SciSciNet extraction.
claim_boundary: Negative real-data smoke test; not a prevalence estimate and not evidence that Sleeping Beauties are absent from the field/year population.
